name: Apollonian
description: Three generations of an Apollonian circle packing: big discs touching in a square grid, middling discs in the hollows between them and tiny discs in the gaps left over.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 1.4%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -30%; top: -30%; width: 160%; height: 160%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @match(x == 1, @match(y == 1, @var(--ap11), @var(--ap10)), @match(y == 1, @var(--ap01), @var(--ap00))); mask: @match(x == 1, @match(y == 1, @var(--ap11), @var(--ap10)), @match(y == 1, @var(--ap01), @var(--ap00))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ap00: radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); --ap10: radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 18.75% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 18.75% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 18.75% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); --ap01: radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); --ap11: radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 81.25% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 18.75% 81.25%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 18.75% 35.08%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 18.75% 64.92%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 81.25% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 35.08% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 2.51% 2.51% at 64.92% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12.07% 12.07% at 18.75% 18.75%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
